Whether that means taking a day off to rest and recharge, pursuing a new hobby that excites you, or simply saying "no" to something that doesn't align with your values, it's all about prioritizing your own well-being. Remember, you are worthy of love and respect simply for being who you are. You don't need to change or compromise yourself to please others.
